learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition and development of basic motor skills and abilities in selected sports: skiing and snowboarding.
Mastering the correct technique of performing individual movements, which are necessary for skiing and snowboarding.

assessment_methods.method: Completion of a multi-day course in its full scope
Completion of one-day courses in the scope of 4 days

assessment_rules: Grades are awarded based on percentages: A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. To earn 1 or 2 credits, students must complete a multi-day course in its entirety or complete one-day courses for a total of 4 days. Students can choose a course that matches their interests, abilities, and deadlines.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
